record.title: Fresnel formulae result
record.name: FresnelFormulaeResult
record.content:
The Fresnel formulae presented in the parent entry-- that the proof refers to-- are as follows:
$$\int_0^\infty\!\cos{x^2}\,dx \,=\, \int_0^\infty\!\sin{x^2}\,dx \,=\, \frac{\sqrt{2\pi}}{4}$$
(visible there only in the Tex code mode because of a current quirk with pstricks vs. Tex).
